data.title: ATEX Stock Jumps After SpaceX Reportedly Eyes 900 MHz Spectrum For Direct-To-Device Expansion; Alternative Target NN Climbs Double Digits
data.description:
Key points:
  • According to Guttman-McCabe, who noted that the company could hand off its remaining licenses to a single party, the company’s remaining spectrum could triple in value with the right buyer. 
  • SpaceX is trying to put together its own retail wireless network and compete with big mobile network operators like Verizon, T-Mobile US, and AT&T Mobility.
  • SpaceX CEO Elon Musk has previously said that his company would take only “2 or 3 years to build a full terrestrial network.

Shares of Anterix Inc. (ATEX) jumped on Friday after a report that Elon Musk’s SpaceX (SPCX) is eyeing an acquisition of the New Jersey company’s 900 MHz licenses to support expansion of its direct-to-device satellite service.

ATEX stock was up 9% at the time of writing, while SPCX shares traded up 4%. Shares of NextNav (NN), another 900 MHz license holder, rose 12%.

Why Is Anterix Looking To Sell?

Anterix has historically leased spectrum to utilities for grid modernization but has opened the door to bigger outright spectrum sales and recurring revenue-generating services, Bloomberg noted. Only about 15% of its holdings are currently used by a handful of utilities, leaving 85% available.

Chris Guttman-McCabe, Anterix’s head of corporate development, told Bloomberg that the company is talking to “all the right parties.” “We’re talking to anyone who can help us drive shareholder value,” he said.

According to Guttman-McCabe, who noted that the company could hand off its remaining licenses to a single party, the company’s remaining spectrum could triple in value with the right buyer.

“Licensed low-band spectrum is hardest to come by, and we have it,” Anterix CEO Scott Lang said on the company’s last earnings call.

Why Is SpaceX Interested in ATEX?

SpaceX, meanwhile, is trying to put together its own retail wireless network and compete with big mobile network operators like Verizon (VZ), T-Mobile US (TMUS), and AT&T Mobility (T). The company previously acquired a significant tranche of spectrum from EchoStar Corp. in 2025 and 800 MHz licenses from Grain Management in October.

VZ and T shares rose around 1% each in afternoon trade. TMUS stock was up around 2%. Retail sentiment across the three telecommunication companies varied, with sentiment in the ‘bullish’ zone for T-Mobile US, in the ‘neutral’ zone for Verizon and in the ‘bearish’ zone for AT&T, over the past day.

Last month, Bloomberg also reported that SpaceX is pursuing agreements for a minimum of 80,000 cell sites across the United States as it advances plans to build a fourth nationwide wireless carrier. The report said that SpaceX is in discussions with at least one major cellular infrastructure company and that Crown Castle Inc. (CCI), among the largest U.S. owners of cellular towers alongside American Tower (AMT) and Vertical Bridge, was also approached for the purpose.

However, late last month, Verizon CEO Dan Schulman dismissed the near-term threat from SpaceX’s network-building ambitions, arguing that any serious challenge in the U.S. mobile market would require a full terrestrial network costing hundreds of billions of dollars and taking four to six years to build. SpaceX CEO Elon Musk disputed the timeline, saying that his company would take only “2 or 3 years.”

Bloomberg noted that the FCC decisions on awarding satellite designation to Anterix’s spectrum could curb its usefulness for the direct-to-device market that SpaceX is trying to scale. Further, SpaceX could also instead buy geolocation service provider NextNav’s 900 MHz airwaves.

How Did ATEX, NN, SPCX Retail Traders React?

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around SPCX and ATEX was trending in ‘bullish’ territory over the past day. Sentiment around NN, meanwhile, stayed within ‘bearish’ levels.

While ATEX stock has soared 275% year-to-date, NN shares have fallen 45%. SPCX, meanwhile, is currently trading at around $131, below its June IPO price of $135.

data.title: Saudi Insurance Industry Could See Further Consolidation Under New Capital Rules — Market Talk
data.description: Saudi Arabia's new capital framework could drive further consolidation in the kingdom's insurance industry, Bahrain-based investment bank SICO says. The framework, effective from 2027, will link insurers' capital requirements to risks associated with their policies and investments. The Saudi Insurance Authority aims to double industry capital to 50 billion riyals by 2030. Smaller insurers with limited capital and weak earnings could need to raise equity, issue subordinated debt or be acquired. Bupa Arabia and Tawuniya, which together accounted for around 82% of first-half sector pretax profit, stand to benefit, SICO says. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)

data.title: Tethys Petroleum Press Release (TPL): Interim Results and Corporate Update
data.description:
Grand Cayman, Cayman Islands--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Tethys Petroleum Limited ("Tethys" or the "Company") today announced that it has filed its interim results for the three months ended September 30, 2026 with the Canadian securities regulatory authorities comprising its Unaudited Financial Statements together with Management's Discussion and Analysis and other required forms. Copies of the filed documents may be obtained via SEDAR at www.sedarplus.ca or on Tethys' website at www.tethys-group.com.

Financial highlights

Oil and gas sales increased by 130% to $16.3 million in the third quarter of 2026 from $7.1 million in 2025 due to increased oil production and commencing processing crude oil into refined products during the quarter. The net profit for the quarter was $.4 million compared with the net profit of $1.4 million in 2025. Profit after tax for the nine-month period was $2.4 million compared with $2.9 million in 2025. This decrease in profit is primarily attributable to lower oil prices. Total oil and gas production for the period was up 32% as compared to 2025. This increased revenue, but profitability was adversely affected by the additional refining, transportation and excise costs associated with increased production volumes, new operating model, higher oil production costs and increased administrative expenses, particularly professional fees.

Average oil production now is approximately 555 tons per day (4,440 bopd).

Cancellation of Auction

The auction for the sale of the TAG pipeline assets commenced as scheduled at 10:00 a.m. local time in Aktobe on November 26th but was interrupted following a technical issue with the electronic auction platform.

The Company has subsequently received formal notification from the electronic auction platform confirming that the auction lot has been cancelled by the organizer due to a database failure on the platform.

Suspension of Enforcement Proceeding

Separately, on November 26, 2026, the private bailiff issued a formal order suspending the enforcement proceedings against TAG, citing the Administrative Court's request for the enforcement case file pursuant to its ruling of November 25, 2026.

The bailiff's order took effect on the date of its issuance. The administrative proceedings remain ongoing, with a preliminary hearing scheduled for December 7, 2026.

The Company continues to pursue its legal remedies and reserves all its rights in relation to the enforcement proceedings and the auction.

Potential Operational Impact

As previously disclosed, the pledged gas pipelines and related infrastructure are used in TAG's gas production and transportation operations, and any future sale to a third party or transfer of the assets to Special Financial Company DSFK LLP, the holder of the security over TAG's assets, could affect TAG's continued access to and use of this infrastructure. Tethys continues to evaluate legal and commercial measures to protect its interests and maintain continuity of operations.

The Company will provide a further update when additional information becomes available.

About Tethys

Tethys is focused on oil and gas exploration and production activities in Central Asia and the Caspian Region. Tethys believes that significant potential exists in both exploration and in discovered deposits in the area.

data.title: Canada Pumps Billions More For Battered Forest Industry
data.description:
By Paul Vieira

OTTAWA--Canada unveiled on Friday a multibillion-dollar plan to reverse the dwindling fortunes of the country's forest-products sector, which is struggling under the weight of U.S. tariffs and faces acute risks unless addressed.

Canada's Natural Resources Minister Tim Hodgson said the task at hand is to revitalize the sector and stop the flight of capital to the U.S. and elsewhere. Alongside hefty tariffs, Canadian officials acknowledged some of the forestry sector's challenges are homegrown, among them chronic underinvestment and regulatory overlap that thwarts access to cost-competitive fiber used in the production of pulp and paper.

For Hodgson's efforts, Canada has allocated an additional 6.5 billion Canadian dollars (US$4.5 billion) for forestry-sector improvements, building on C$3 billion provided in August 2025 to help with the fallout from U.S. tariffs. All told, the Canadian government has made available roughly C$33 billion in financing for all trade-exposed companies, and about C$10 billion in direct support for affected workers.

Most Canadian exports of softwood lumber - used in the construction of houses - face U.S. duties and tariffs of nearly 35%. Ottawa and Washington have engaged in a decades-long row about lumber products, with U.S. officials accusing Canada of unfairly subsidizing its forest industry.

Officials added forest-product exports have dropped 22% since President Trump imposed further duties on the sector. This has led to the closure of 12 Canadian sawmills, and output curtails in 40 other plants, the officials added.

Hodgson said the government wants to improve access to fibre, accelerate innovation in the sector, and drive domestic demand for Canadian forest products. "Business as usual is no longer an option for our forest sector," he said, adding the government's plan is meant to help the sector navigate current challenges and secure its future.

The additional money for Canada's forest sector is in response to findings from a government-appointed task force, which this year warned the industry faces an existential risk. "Continued inaction will accelerate capital flight, erode skilled workforces, destabilize rural and Indigenous communities, and forgo a generational opportunity to position Canada as a leader in the emerging global bioeconomy," the task force said.

Canada is home to nearly 10% of the world's forests, and about 40% of the country is covered by timberland. But the sector's economic heft has weakened considerably over the decades. Government data indicate that forest products account for about 1% of Canada's gross domestic product, down from a 3% level over two decades ago. Meanwhile, employment in the sector is about 40% below 2004 levels, and softwood-lumber production has declined by nearly a third from 2017 levels.

Of the C$6.5 billion made available, officials said about one-quarter of that cash will be focused on improving productivity at existing sawmills, while the remaining monies are expected to invest in new large-scale factories to accelerate the development of advanced forest products.

Write to Paul Vieira at paul.vieira@wsj.com

data.title: ADBE Stock On Track For 4-Day Rally: Adobe Reports Surge In AI Traffic, $7.1B Thanksgiving Sales
data.description:
Key points:
  • Adobe projects AI-driven retail traffic will rise 130% overall this holiday season and 95% on Black Friday.
  • AI-referred shoppers are generating 83% higher revenue per visit and converting at a 90% higher rate this holiday season, Adobe said.
  • Cyber Monday is projected to be the first single day to eclipse $15 billion in U.S. online spending.

U.S. shoppers are increasingly leaning on AI tools to compare models, evaluate specifications, and weigh alternatives before visiting a retailer's website or store, according to Adobe's 2026 holiday shopping data.

According to Adobe’s holiday sales trends report for 2026, stronger digital demand is propelling overall e-commerce growth this season. Marta Frattini, the global retail and consumer strategy lead at Adode, said in a LinkedIn post that the company projects online Black Friday sales will reach $12.9 billion, up 9.2% from a year earlier, followed by an expected $15.1 billion on Cyber Monday—a projected single-day record spend as per Adobe.

Thanksgiving sales alone came in at $7.1 billion, Adobe said. ADBE stock gained about 1% on Friday and is set to end its fourth consecutive session higher.

Value Shoppers Are Relying On AI 

Adobe also forecast AI-referred traffic to U.S. retail sites will climb 130% year over year (YoY) across the holiday season, including a 159% jump on Thanksgiving and a 95% rise on Black Friday.

Separate findings cited within the report showed AI-referred visitors generated 83% more revenue per visit and converted 90% better than other traffic, while 69% of shoppers say they are less likely to return an item bought with help from an AI assistant.

AI-driven traffic to retail sites grew 127% YoY in August 2026 and is projected to remain strong through the holidays, with traffic expected to grow 130% YoY overall and 159% YoY on Thanksgiving as per Adobe.

Consumers are stretching their budgets across both gifts and everyday necessities, using AI to scout for holiday discounts to save on basics such as clothing staples, personal hygiene items, and household cleaning supplies alongside electronics, toys, and apparel.

Electronics are expected to dominate 2026 holiday sales, bringing in $63.3 billion in sales this year’s holiday season followed by apparel.

ADBE Stock: Retail View 

Retail sentiment on Stocktwits around Adobe rose to ‘neutral’ from ‘bearish’ territory over the past day, with ‘normal’ levels of message volume around the stock.

ADBE stock has lost about 33% year-to-date.

data.title: Advantage Energy holder to vote against sale to Canadian Natural Resources
data.description:
Andvantage Energy holder LetkoBrosseau said it plans to vote against its  sale to Canadian Natural Resources and urges fellow holders to reject the offer.

LetkoBrosseau, which has a 5.5% stake in Advantage Energy , is against the deal, as it “significantly undervalues” the company's "high-quality" asset base and long-term potential, according to a statement on Friday.

"CNQ's proposal represents highly opportunistic timing designed to acquire premier, long-life assets at the bottom of the natural gas cycle and during a period of leadership transition," LetkoBrosseau said in the statement. "But given Advantage's leading asset base and strong financial position, it should feel no pressure to pursue a deal now. In fact, when further considering the industry's accelerating M&A environment, the company actually possesses an enviable negotiating position; it is thus weakly playing what is in reality a very good hand."

The comments come after Canadian Natural last Monday said it agreed to acquire Advantage Energy () for ~C$2.53 (US$1.77B), including debt, bolstering the company's position in western Canada. Canadian Natural said it will pay C$13.55/share for Advantage , a nearly 20% premium.

data.title: Saudi Banks Face Funding Pressure as Government Deposits Decline — Market Talk
data.description: Saudi banks face funding pressure as lending expansion continues to outpace deposit growth, Riyadh-based investment firm Riyad Capital says. The private-sector loan-to-deposit ratio rose to 108% in September from 104.3% in June. Private-sector credit grew 6.0% on year in September, compared with customer deposit growth of 4.8%. Government institutions withdrew 59 billion riyals ($15.7 billion) from commercial-bank deposits between July and September. Customers have also continued shifting funds toward interest-bearing time and savings deposits. Meanwhile, the Saudi central bank's official foreign reserves fell by 108 billion riyals to 1.746 trillion riyals during the third quarter. (farhan.rafid@wsj.com)

data.title: Neural Therapeutics Announces Anticipated Delay in Annual Filings and Application for Management Cease Trade Order
data.description:
Toronto, Ontario--(Newsfile Corp. - November 27, 2026) - Neural Therapeutics Inc. (FSE: HANF) ("Neural" or the "Company") announces that it anticipates being unable to file its audited annual financial statements for the year ended July 31, 2026, the related management's discussion and analysis and the related CEO and CFO certificates (collectively, the "Required Filings") by the prescribed filing deadline of November 30, 2026.

The anticipated delay is primarily attributable to additional accounting, financial reporting and audit work associated with the Company's acquisition of a 30.75% interest in CWE European Holdings Inc. ("CWE"). As a minority investor with significant influence but without control of CWE, the Company relies on CWE's management and financial reporting personnel for the timely delivery of financial information and supporting documentation. CWE's operations are principally conducted through subsidiaries in Germany, and differences in time zones, accounting systems and personnel availability have contributed to delays in obtaining, reconciling and reviewing the information required to account for the investment. CWE's management and financial reporting personnel continue to cooperate with the Company. The change of auditors during the financial year and changes in financial reporting personnel have also contributed to the timing of the annual reporting process. Management had expected to meet the filing deadline but, following a review of the outstanding work, concluded that the deadline was unlikely to be met.

The Company's auditors, Kreston GTA LLP, have commenced audit fieldwork. The Company has substantially completed its standalone financial reporting work and provided most of the information requested to date. Management is working closely with CWE and the auditors to complete the outstanding work and currently expects to make the Required Filings on or before December 31, 2026. The Company will file the Required Filings as soon as they are available. The completion date is an estimate and remains subject to the resolution of outstanding matters and completion of the audit. As a contingency, the Company is requesting that the principal regulator allow until January 29, 2027, if required.

The Company has applied to the Ontario Securities Commission, as its principal regulator, for a management cease trade order ("MCTO") pursuant to National Policy 12-203 - Management Cease Trade Orders ("NP 12-203"), as an alternative to a failure-to-file cease trade order against the Company. The MCTO, if granted on the terms requested, would restrict trading in securities of the Company by its CEO and CFO but would not generally prevent other shareholders from trading in the Company's securities. There is no assurance that the MCTO will be granted. If the MCTO is not granted and the Required Filings are not completed by the prescribed deadline, the applicable securities regulators may issue a failure-to-file cease trade order.

In support of the MCTO application, Northern Star Capital Inc., a shareholder controlled by the Company's CFO, has undertaken to advance up to $25,000 to the Company to fund outstanding audit fees, related filing costs and essential operating expenditures during the requested remediation period. The undertaking is conditional upon confirmation from staff of the Ontario Securities Commission that staff is otherwise prepared to recommend issuance of the MCTO, subject to confirmation of funding. The requisite funds would be advanced prior to issuance of the MCTO. No funds have been received pursuant to this undertaking as at the date of this release.

The Company intends to satisfy the alternative information guidelines under NP 12-203 for so long as it remains in default, including the issuance of biweekly default status reports in the form of news releases. The Company's directors and officers are subject to a trading blackout and will remain so throughout the default period, subject to the applicable policy and regulatory restrictions. The Company is not subject to any bankruptcy, insolvency or receivership proceedings. Other than the matters disclosed herein, there is no material information concerning the affairs of the Company that has not been generally disclosed.

About Neural Therapeutics Inc.

Neural Therapeutics is an ethnobotanical drug discovery company focused on developing therapeutic drugs for mental health conditions related to substance use disorders, including alcohol and opioid dependence. In August 2025, Neural completed the first stage of its investment in CWE, acquiring a 30.75% ownership interest in the company, which operates the Hanf.com retail and e-commerce business in Germany.

About CWE European Holdings Inc.

CWE, through its subsidiaries in Germany, operates the Hanf.com brand, including a network of specialty retail stores, e-commerce operations and a growing B2B business focused on CBD products, related wellness goods and accessories. Hanf.com operates 17 stores across Germany, including 15 company-owned locations and two franchised locations. Its operations are principally located in Germany, with a significant presence in Bavaria.
